body: Suggestion 2 of [the System One cost audit](docs/cost/2026-10-02-system-one-cost-efficiency-audit.md). A standing Gym study that runs the same tasks through raw Claude Code, raw Codex, and OpenAgents' shipped default path (plus a matched arm with the same model/settings), on Terminal-Bench tasks and real repo issues, with the pass bar fixed in advance, and reports cost, time and outcome per task and in total. This is the number behind "OpenAgents is cheaper than raw delegation".
title: Gym study: OpenAgents vs raw Claude Code / Codex on the same tasks (cost, time, outcome)
